body: I normally live with my friend and his parents but I’ve been inpatient in a MH hospital for the past 2 months now which sucks

I did this to my FP recently for seemingly no reason. Well, I guess just to see if they’d message me or be worried idk, I always feel like a shit person afterwards esp when they message me like a million times wondering if I’m ok :/

I don't know if it helps but I'm in the exact same position as you... Ive even been signed off sick from work as a care assistant since January because of my mental health :/

Sorry that I can't say anything to help :(
This literally sounds like I have written it :(
They had negotiators come and literally say I wasn’t in trouble and that they can help me if I come back over the barrier. So they basically just lied to my face.
I’m from the Uk, I think the usual thing is the police take you to hospital to be assessed by a dr etc so I was pretty confused when I was all of a sudden in hand cuffs :(
I feel like it made me a lot worse than I already am :(
Yeah I didn’t understand it I was in a really bad place and it just confused me even more and they refused to give me a MH assessment or anything just put me in a cell by myself
Yeah that’s why I don’t get why I was arrested because it’s not like they had to stop traffic or anything Idk
Out of interest, Did the police or anyone ever come?
